title: Material for MkDocs extra keys
description: The keys below `extra` the Material for MkDocs theme reads.

reserved.description: The keys below `extra` other features own, which this model must never describe or overwrite.

fields.description: The keys the theme owns, in the order the settings page and the schema list them.

name.description: The key as it is written in the configuration file.

kind.description: The shape of the value below the key.

descriptionKey.description: The bundle key of the one line description.

children.description: The keys below this one, absent unless `kind` describes a mapping.
